name: Carolina Hurricanes at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — Andrei Svechnikov scored the shootout winner and Antti Raanta made 24 saves as the Carolina Hurricanes edged the New Jersey Devils 5-4 on Sunday for a franchise-best 11th straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Svechnikov scores in shootout, Hurricanes beat Devils 5-4

name: New York Rangers at Florida Panthers

headlines.description: — Mika Zibanejad scored twice and the New York Rangers snapped a two-game skid with a 5-3 win over the Florida Panthers on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zibanejad nets 2, Rangers beat Panthers to snap 2-game slide

name: San Jose Sharks at Chicago Blackhawks

headlines.description: — Marc-Edouard Vlasic made his NHL debut way back in 2006. And even he is impressed with what fellow defenseman Erik Karlsson is doing right now.
headlines.shortLinkText: Karlsson gets franchise record as Sharks beat Blackhawks 5-2

headlines.description: — Jacob Lucchini’s first NHL goal was the eventual winner as the Ottawa Senators beat Buffalo 3-1 Sunday night and snapped the Sabres' six-game winning streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lucchini scores 1st, Senators end Sabres' 6-game win streak

name: New York Islanders at Seattle Kraken

headlines.description: — Eeli Tolvanen scored his first goal in a Seattle uniform since coming over from Nashville, and the Kraken halted a three-game winless streak on Sunday night by beating the New York Islanders 4-1.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kraken snap 3-game skid with 4-1 win over NY Islanders
